remarks: Welcome to Stonegate Condominiums in the heart of East Aurora. This spacious second floor condo offers comfortable one level living with two bedrooms, two full bathrooms and 966 square feet of well planned living space. The bright kitchen features abundant cabinetry, generous counter space, a breakfast bar and included appliances (new dishwasher), opening naturally to the living and dining areas. The spacious living room is accented by exposed wood beams and provides access to a private balcony overlooking a peaceful green setting. Both bedrooms offer excellent closet space, including a generously sized primary bedroom with its own full bathroom. A second full bathroom provides additional convenience. The full basement offers valuable additional space with laundry and plenty of storage. Central air conditioning and forced air heat provide year round comfort. Stonegate residents enjoy access to a beautiful community in-ground pool, along with next door access to Know Farm State Park. The association provides common area maintenance, exterior building maintenance, master insurance, reserve fund contributions, snow removal, trash collection and water. Enjoy low maintenance living just minutes from everything the Village of East Aurora has to offer, including its shops, restaurants and vibrant village atmosphere. A wonderful opportunity to enjoy the convenience of condominium living in the highly regarded East Aurora School District.
